candidates.source_name: ČNB – Seznamy a evidence (hub for all supervisory lists and registers)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index page of every list/register the ČNB is legally obliged to publish (JERRS, prospectus registers, other lists, open data, WS JERRS). Single crawl entry point that snowballs into all register-type sources for CZ banking and payments.
candidates.legal_status: public sector information, official publication duty
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML crawl of the hub, diff link inventory to detect newly added lists/registers
queries_used: ČNB seznamy a registry regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů JERRS
CNB list of regulated entities payment institutions register JERRS web services

candidates.source_name: JERRS – Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů finančního trhu (application)
candidates.why_relevant: The authoritative register of every licensed, registered, notified or listed financial-market entity in CZ – banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, small-scale providers, CASPs, intermediaries. Each entity record is itself a pointer to a further actor whose own compliance/investor pages become sources.
candidates.access_status: open, no login required for public search
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer WS JERRS or open-data CSV where the sub-list is covered; otherwise parameterised HTTP queries against the JERRS servlet with polite rate limiting
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs web search, snowballed from Seznamy a evidence hub
queries_used: ČNB seznamy a registry regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů JERRS

candidates.source_name: JERRS – Vznik a zánik subjektů (entities newly authorised / terminated in a period)
candidates.why_relevant: Menu function inside JERRS that returns entities whose authorisation arose or ceased during a chosen period. This is the single highest-signal change feed for market-entry / exit intelligence: new payment-institution licences, withdrawn permissions, lapsed small-scale providers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled monthly query with a rolling date window; store deltas keyed on IČO + role
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs web search result snippet describing the JERRS menu
queries_used: ČNB seznamy a registry regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů JERRS

candidates.source_name: WS JERRS – ČNB register web services (SOAP/XML)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable, officially sanctioned access to JERRS since 1.7.2019. Three services: subject detail (identification, seat, authorisation dates, permitted activities, relations), subject list by role, and list of representatives. The correct long-term ingestion channel instead of scraping.
candidates.access_status: gated – requires registration and a commercial qualified certificate
candidates.legal_status: explicitly offered for controlled external use by the regulator
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Apply for access by electronically signed request to jerrsws@cnb.cz (identification of applicant, contact person, certificate serial + issuer); then scheduled SOAP calls against https://aplc.cnb.cz/jerrsws/ws with certificate auth from eIdentity / I.CA / Postsignum or an EU trust-list CA
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched the WS JERRS documentation page
queries_used: ČNB webové služby JERRS export dat
candidates.observed_blocker: Certificate-based authentication and prior written access approval required; no anonymous endpoint use.

candidates.source_name: ČNB Otevřená data (open data downloads from JERRS, CSV + JSON schema)
candidates.why_relevant: Seven statutory open datasets published under nařízení vlády 425/2016 Sb.: banks and foreign bank branches, exchange offices (směnárny), non-bank consumer-credit providers, independent and tied credit intermediaries, tied representatives, foreign credit intermediaries. Direct stable CSV endpoints with documented JSON schemas – the cheapest reliable structured feed of regulated CZ actors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily/weekly HTTP GET of each p_seznam=1..7 CSV endpoint; hash and diff to detect additions/removals
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched the Otevřená data page linked from the Seznamy hub
queries_used: ČNB webové služby JERRS export dat
data.gov.cz Česká národní banka datové sady otevřená data

candidates.source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (NKOD) – ČNB datasets
candidates.why_relevant: The national open-data catalogue carries ČNB dataset records with DCAT metadata (distribution URLs, update frequency 'daily', contact seznamy.subjektu@cnb.cz). Useful for discovering ČNB datasets we did not know existed and for machine-readable freshness metadata.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the NKOD catalogue for publisher = Česká národní banka (IČO 48136450) and harvest distribution URLs

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Pravomocná rozhodnutí České národní banky (final administrative decisions hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains and links every statutory publication duty for enforcement outcomes, by sector and legal basis: banks (z. 21/1992 §26ab, §36j), credit unions (87/1995), payment services (z. 370/2017 §236 – fines on payment institutions), exchange offices (277/2013), consumer credit (257/2016), AML (253/2008 §53, operative parts published 5 years), capital market (15/1998 §14), and MiCA/DORA sanctions (EU 2023/1114, 2022/2554). This is the enforcement face of supervision for our cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the hub and its per-sector children; capture legal basis mapping once and refresh quarterly
queries_used: ČNB pravomocná rozhodnutí správní řízení pokuty přehled sankčních rozhodnutí platební instituce

candidates.source_name: ČNB ABOK – application of final decisions in proceedings started after 1.1.2009
candidates.why_relevant: The searchable database behind the enforcement publication duty: individual sanction decisions (fines, remedial measures, licence withdrawals) against banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, exchange offices and intermediaries from 2009 onward. Primary evidence for enforcement-trend and compliance-pressure analysis.
candidates.access_status: believed open; not verified in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic search by decision date range; download decision PDFs and extract entity, legal basis, sanction type and amount
candidates.discovered_via_method: linked from the pravomocná rozhodnutí hub page
queries_used: ČNB pravomocná rozhodnutí správní řízení pokuty přehled sankčních rozhodnutí platební instituce

candidates.source_name: ČNB decision PDF repository (export/sites/cnb .galleries/prilohy)
candidates.why_relevant: Full-text PDFs of individual ČNB decisions are served from a predictable static path (e.g. S-Sp-2020_00436_CNB_573.pdf). Allows full-text extraction of reasoning, legal grounds and fine amounts rather than just a decision index line.

candidates.why_relevant: Running list of platforms and entities the ČNB flags as offering financial-market services in CZ without authorisation. The negative counterpart of the register: shows enforcement attention, fraud typologies and unlicensed payment/crypto activity in near real time.

negative_findings.description: The seven ČNB open-data CSV datasets cover banks, exchange offices, consumer-credit providers and credit intermediaries, but NOT payment institutions, e-money institutions, small-scale payment service providers (PSMR) or small-scale e-money issuers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched the Otevřená data page and the payments legislation landing page in cs; found no p_seznam CSV endpoint for platební instituce. Those lists appear reachable only through the JERRS UI or WS JERRS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments half of the run scope has no free bulk feed; collection must go through WS JERRS (certificate-gated) or careful UI querying, which changes the effort and legal profile of the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: WS JERRS, the only officially sanctioned machine interface to the full register, requires an electronically signed application to jerrsws@cnb.cz and authentication with a commercial qualified certificate (eIdentity, I.CA, Postsignum or an EU trust-list CA).
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed from the ČNB WS JERRS documentation page. No anonymous or API-key tier was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Onboarding lead time and a certificate purchase sit between us and the best data source in this cell; it must be started early rather than discovered at build time.

negative_findings.description: The final-decisions application at abok.cnb.cz was identified only from a link on the ČNB pravomocná rozhodnutí hub; its search interface, query parameters and whether it exposes structured export were not inspected in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not fetched. Treated as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Enforcement decisions are the core of the sanctions half of this cell; the ingestion design cannot be finalised until the application's interface is examined.

negative_findings.description: No single consolidated, machine-readable list of ČNB sanctions across all sectors was found; publication duties are fragmented across at least 11 separate sectoral statutes with differing retention rules (e.g. AML decisions published for 5 years after finality, insurance licence withdrawals within 30 days).
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed by reading the pravomocná rozhodnutí hub, which enumerates the legal bases one by one rather than pointing to a unified register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any enforcement time series we build must reconcile heterogeneous, time-limited publication regimes, or it will understate historical AML sanctions.

negative_findings.description: The Czech word 'seznam' is highly ambiguous — Seznam.cz is the dominant Czech search engine, so queries containing 'seznam' return search-engine and unrelated commercial pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: The first cs query returned a search.seznam.cz result and a logistics academy page among the top hits.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future automated query generation for this cell should pair 'seznam' with disambiguating tokens ('ČNB', 'regulovaných subjektů', 'JERRS') or scope searches to cnb.cz.

coverage_gaps.description: The JERRS web application's query URL structure (roles, list codes, pagination, export options) was not mapped; only the login/entry URLs are known.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a hands-on browser session against apl.cnb.cz/apljerrsdad to map role codes and any CSV/print export, and record the parameter grammar for the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Passporting notifications — foreign payment institutions, e-money institutions and banks notified to operate in CZ under freedom of services/establishment, and CZ entities passporting out — were not located as a distinct ČNB list in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search cs terms 'notifikace', 'volný pohyb služeb', 'svoboda usazování', 'jednotný evropský pas' on cnb.cz, and cross-check the EBA credit-institutions and payment-institutions registers for CZ.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-ČNB Czech registers that complement the supervisory ones — obchodní rejstřík / justice.cz, ARES, evidence skutečných majitelů (UBO register), and the Finanční analytický úřad (FAÚ) AML side — were out of this cell's scope but are needed to resolve entity identity and ownership behind register entries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign ARES/justice.cz/ESM and FAÚ to another cell, or extend this one, so IČO-keyed enrichment of register entries is possible.

coverage_gaps.description: Register snapshots are current-state only; JERRS does not obviously expose historical states beyond the vznik/zánik query, and open-data CSVs are overwritten.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin our own snapshot archive immediately (versioned storage of every CSV and query result) so a time series exists from run start onward; also check the Internet Archive for past snapshots of the open-data endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: The English mirror of ČNB pages exists but was only spot-checked; whether the EN site carries the same register links and the same freshness as the CS site is unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compare the cs and en Seznamy/lists-registers hubs link-by-link once; if EN lags, pin the collector to CS URLs and use EN only for terminology.

brief: The CZ register landscape for banking and payments is centred almost entirely on the Czech National Bank, which is statutorily obliged to publish who is licensed and who has been sanctioned. The authoritative layer is JERRS (Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů), reachable three ways with very different access profiles: a public web application, seven free open-data CSV/JSON datasets that notably exclude payment and e-money institutions, and the certificate-gated WS JERRS SOAP services that are the only sanctioned bulk machine interface. The enforcement face sits separately under Pravomocná rozhodnutí and the ABOK decision database, fragmented across at least eleven sectoral publication duties (payments under §236 z. 370/2017, AML under §53 z. 253/2008, plus new MiCA/DORA sanction duties), complemented by the Upozornění warning list of unlicensed actors. Highest-value next steps are applying for WS JERRS access, mapping the JERRS query grammar and the vznik/zánik delta feed, and closing the passporting-notification gap via the EBA and ESMA registers that ČNB itself links to.
